ruleDefinitions.name: T1133 — RDP to DC via Compromised Service Account (Fact #13)
ruleDefinitions.description: RDP to DC via Compromised Service Account. Trigger: Logon session granted sensitive privileges (SeBackup/SeDebug) for a service account
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Service account {domain_user_name} was granted a 4672 special-privilege logon on {host}
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
